en: Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a woman in an ornate gown and tiara, seated sideways on a carved wooden bench, resting her head on her gloved hands. The style is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century theatrical or aristocratic fashion. A scripted name appears in the upper right corner, and a small number is printed in the lower left corner, suggesting a mass‑produced picture postcard of a performer or celebrity.
